name: A vinyl record sleeve
vera_note: Orange and white. The spine reads MIRIAM CROSS — ORDINARY TIME. The record itself is gone — not lost, I think, but taken deliberately, kept close by someone while the sleeve was left behind. The liner notes are still inside, folded twice. Three hundred words about a musician who made one album and then didn't. The last line: 'Miriam thanks no one in particular and everyone she has ever met.' The record went somewhere. I hope it was played.
